summary.text: COMEN01C is the CICS pseudo-conversational main (regular user) menu of CardDemo, transaction CM00, map COMEN1A of mapset COMEN01. Without a commarea it transfers to the sign-on program COSGN00C; on first entry from another program it sets the re-enter flag and displays the option list built from the COMEN02Y table (11 options). On ENTER it normalises the typed option number, validates it against CDEMO-MENU-OPT-COUNT, blocks admin-only options for regular users, and XCTLs to the program of the chosen option with the CARDDEMO-COMMAREA; COPAUS0C is first checked with INQUIRE PROGRAM and DUMMY placeholders are shown as 'coming soon'. PF3 returns to COSGN00C; other keys redisplay the menu with an invalid-key message. Each turn ends with CICS RETURN TRANSID(CM00) COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA).

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.logic: Clears the error flag and message. If EIBCALEN = 0 it moves 'COSGN00C' to CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM and performs RETURN-TO-SIGNON-SCREEN. Otherwise it copies DFHCOMMAREA into CARDDEMO-COMMAREA; if CDEMO-PGM-REENTER is not set it sets it, clears COMEN1AO and sends the menu; else it receives the map and evaluates EIBAID: ENTER performs PROCESS-ENTER-KEY, PF3 sets CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM='COSGN00C' and returns to sign-on, other keys redisplay with CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY. Ends with CICS RETURN TRANSID('CM00') and the commarea.

paragraphs.name: PROCESS-ENTER-KEY
paragraphs.logic: Finds the last non-space character of OPTIONI, moves the significant part into right-justified WS-OPTION-X, replaces spaces with '0' and moves it to numeric WS-OPTION. Rejects non-numeric, zero or > CDEMO-MENU-OPT-COUNT options with 'Please enter a valid option number...', and rejects options with user type 'A' for CDEMO-USRTYP-USER users with 'No access - Admin Only option... '. When no error: COPAUS0C is XCTLed only if EXEC CICS INQUIRE PROGRAM returns NORMAL (else red 'This option ... is not installed...'); programs starting 'DUMMY' produce a green 'coming soon' message; any other option sets CDEMO-FROM-TRANID/PROGRAM, CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT=0 and XCTLs to CDEMO-MENU-OPT-PGMNAME(WS-OPTION). If no XCTL occurred, the menu is redisplayed.

paragraphs.name: RETURN-TO-SIGNON-SCREEN
paragraphs.logic: Defaults CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM to 'COSGN00C' when it is low-values or spaces, then XCTLs to CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM without a commarea.

paragraphs.name: SEND-MENU-SCREEN
paragraphs.logic: Performs POPULATE-HEADER-INFO and BUILD-MENU-OPTIONS, moves WS-MESSAGE to ERRMSGO and sends map COMEN1A (mapset COMEN01) with ERASE.

paragraphs.name: RECEIVE-MENU-SCREEN
paragraphs.logic: Receives map COMEN1A of mapset COMEN01 into COMEN1AI capturing RESP/RESP2 (not tested afterwards).

paragraphs.name: POPULATE-HEADER-INFO
paragraphs.logic: Moves titles, transaction id CM00, program name, current date (MM/DD/YY) and time (HH:MM:SS) from FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE to the map header fields.

paragraphs.name: BUILD-MENU-OPTIONS
paragraphs.logic: Loops WS-IDX from 1 to CDEMO-MENU-OPT-COUNT, builds 'nn. option name' from CDEMO-MENU-OPT-NUM and CDEMO-MENU-OPT-NAME and moves it to screen line OPTN001O..OPTN012O according to WS-IDX; indexes beyond 12 are ignored.

rules.statement: The menu option entered must be numeric, not zero and not greater than the number of configured options (CDEMO-MENU-OPT-COUNT, 11 in COMEN02Y); otherwise the menu is redisplayed with 'Please enter a valid option number...'. Before the test, trailing blanks are dropped and embedded/leading blanks are replaced by zeros, so ' 5' and '5 ' both mean option 5.
rules.conditions: WS-OPTION IS NOT NUMERIC or WS-OPTION > CDEMO-MENU-OPT-COUNT or WS-OPTION = 0
rules.outcome: Error flag set; menu redisplayed with message; no transfer
messages: Please enter a valid option number...

rules.statement: A regular user (CDEMO-USER-TYPE 'U') may not select a menu option flagged admin-only (CDEMO-MENU-OPT-USRTYPE = 'A'); the menu is redisplayed with 'No access - Admin Only option... ' and no transfer happens. In the current COMEN02Y table every option is flagged 'U', so the check never fires with the shipped configuration.
rules.outcome: Error flag set; menu redisplayed with message

rules.statement: A valid, permitted option whose program is neither COPAUS0C nor a DUMMY placeholder transfers control (XCTL) to the program named in CDEMO-MENU-OPT-PGMNAME for that option, passing the commarea with from-transaction CM00, from-program COMEN01C and program context 0 (first entry). Options 1-10 map to COACTVWC, COACTUPC, COCRDLIC, COCRDSLC, COCRDUPC, COTRN00C, COTRN01C, COTRN02C, CORPT00C, COBIL00C.
rules.conditions: Error flag off and option program not COPAUS0C and not starting 'DUMMY'
rules.outcome: XCTL to option program with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA

rules.statement: The menu distinguishes first entry from re-entry with CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT: when entered from another program (context not 1) it sets CDEMO-PGM-REENTER and only displays the menu; screen input is received and acted on only on re-entry. A call without any commarea is sent back to sign-on (COSGN00C).
rules.outcome: No commarea: XCTL to COSGN00C. First entry: menu sent. Re-entry: map received and key processed.

rules.statement: On the main menu any key other than ENTER or PF3 is rejected: the menu is redisplayed with 'Invalid key pressed. Please see below...' and no option is processed.
messages: Invalid key pressed. Please see below...

existing_rules_reviewed.note: Confirmed for COMEN01C; the XCTL at 201-203 passes no commarea. The COADM01C half is reviewed in COADM01C.json.
PF3 sets CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM to 'COSGN00C' and performs RETURN-TO-SIGNON-SCREEN (XCTL without commarea).
INQUIRE PROGRAM ... NOHANDLE; when not NORMAL the message 'This option <name> is not installed...' is shown in red (DFHRED). On success CDEMO-FROM-TRANID/PROGRAM and context 0 are set before XCTL.
Message built as 'This option ' + option name up to the first space + 'is coming soon ...' in green. No COMEN02Y entry currently starts with DUMMY, so this branch is dormant.

no_rule_decisions.reason: BUILD-MENU-OPTIONS loop and EVALUATE WS-IDX only place option text on screen lines OPTN001O-OPTN012O (presentation).

observations.text: After an invalid option (zero, non-numeric or > count) the error flag is set but the next IF still subscripts CDEMO-MENU-OPT-USRTYPE(WS-OPTION); with WS-OPTION = 0 or > 12 this is an out-of-range subscript, and if the condition evaluated true the map would be sent twice.
Every COMEN02Y option has user type 'U' and none starts with 'DUMMY', so the admin-only check and the coming-soon branch never fire with the shipped table.

Coming-soon message truncates the option name at the first space and the literal 'is coming soon ...' has no leading space (e.g. 'This option Accountis coming soon ...'). The not-installed message uses DELIMITED BY '  ' instead.
MOVE WS-PGMNAME TO CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM is duplicated; commented-out moves of WS-USER-ID/SEC-USR-TYPE remain.
RECEIVE MAP RESP/RESP2 are never tested, and the XCTL to option programs has no RESP/HANDLE, so a missing program would abend (only COPAUS0C is pre-checked).
COMEN01C copies CSUSR01Y and defines WS-USRSEC-FILE 'USRSEC' but never reads the file.

sme_questions.question: Is the admin-only flag in COMEN02Y intended to be used (e.g. 'Transaction Add (Admin Only)' was commented out)? If not, can the access check be dropped in the target design?
Why is only COPAUS0C pre-checked with INQUIRE PROGRAM? Is the pending-authorization module an optional install?
